test_message: Generate LinkedIn Ad Brief targeting VP Engineering personas with pain points around cloud cost optimization

ad_brief.target_audience: VP Engineering professionals in mid to large-sized tech companies
ad_brief.narrative_hook: Transform your cloud spending into a strategic advantage.
ad_brief.pain_point: Struggling with unpredictable cloud costs that eat into your engineering budget.
ad_brief.value_proposition: Unlock significant savings while optimizing performance with our cloud cost management solutions.
ad_brief.cta: Discover how to minimize cloud costs today!
ad_brief.creative_concept: Showcase a split-screen video: on one side, a frustrated VP engineers looking at spiraling cloud costs; on the other, a satisfied VP enjoying savings and performance gains after implementation of our solution.

result.brief_summary: This ad brief targets VP Engineering personas, addressing their challenges with cloud cost optimization and presenting a compelling solution with a clear call to action.
